**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a mixed buffet-style plate. It holds a braised meat leg (lamb shank or duck leg), two nigiri pieces topped with cured tuna, a bread roll, a whole red apple, and two small orange baked rounds (cheese soufflé or savoury muffins).

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** It is a large white dinner plate, about 27 cm across. Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Braised meat leg on the bone
- 2 tuna nigiri
- Bread roll
- Red apple
- 2 orange baked rounds

No visible sauce or oil.

| Item | % of plate | Area |

| Bread roll | 13% | ~75 cm² |
| Apple | 7% | ~40 cm² |
| Orange rounds | 12% | ~70 cm² (2 × 35 cm²) |

| **Total** | **~55%** | |

| Apple | 150 g × 52 kcal/100 g | 78 kcal |

| Nigiri | 65 g × 150 kcal/100 g | 98 kcal |
| Meat (edible) | 150 g × 230 kcal/100 g | 345 kcal |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 575 g of edible food and about 1,040 kcal. That is plausible for a well-filled buffet plate with a whole apple, a full roll and a meat portion on the bone.
